slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the aircraft carry both a heavy bomb and a light bomb simultaneously on a single bombing run to a target, or is each run limited to carrying only one bomb (either heavy or light)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed the per-trip carrying capacity, directly covering the one-bomb-per-trip constraint.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission objective to maximize the probability that at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is it to guarantee (with certainty) that at least two parts are destroyed?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked about the objective, matching the maximization-of-probability hidden fact.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both the P0 objective slot and the P1 one-bomb-per-trip slot were resolved early (turns 1 and 6), but the agent then looped, repeating the identical fuel-consumption-formula question from turns 18 through 30 without ever progressing to a model or READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered both hidden slots (objective and one-bomb-per-trip) with well-targeted questions, but then became stuck repeating the same fuel-formula question many times and never converged to a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
